storeInfo.name: Lasowiak Polish Deli Baker & Grocery
storeInfo.tagline: Authentic Polish flavors in the heart of Bridgeport | Sabores polacos auténticos en el corazón de Bridgeport

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en el lote contiguo o en la calle.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Parking available in adjacent lot or street parking.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por la satisfacción total; por favor notifique a su mesero de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.descriptionEs: Sopa tradicional polaca de remolacha clara, servida con pequeñas empanadillas de champiñones.
products.descriptionEn: Traditional clear Polish beetroot soup, served with small mushroom-filled dumplings.

products.descriptionEs: Empanadillas polacas rellenas de papa y queso, servidas con cebolla caramelizada y crema agria.
products.descriptionEn: Polish dumplings filled with potato and cheese, served with caramelized onions and sour cream.

products.descriptionEs: Hojas de repollo tierno rellenas de carne molida sazonada y arroz, bañadas en salsa de tomate casera.
products.descriptionEn: Tender cabbage leaves stuffed with seasoned ground meat and rice, smothered in homemade tomato sauce.

products.descriptionEs: Un estofado robusto de chucrut, carne de cerdo, salchicha polaca y setas silvestres.
products.descriptionEn: A hearty stew of sauerkraut, pork, Polish sausage, and wild mushrooms.

products.descriptionEs: Dona tradicional frita rellena de mermelada de rosa o ciruela, espolvoreada con azúcar.
products.descriptionEn: Traditional deep-fried doughnut filled with rose hip or plum jam, dusted with sugar.

faqs.aEs: Sí, ofrecemos pierogi de queso y papa, además de varias sopas sin carne.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer cheese and potato pierogi, as well as several meat-free soups.

faqs.qEn: Do you sell Polish grocery items?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con una sección de abarrotes con importaciones de Polonia.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we have a grocery section featuring imports from Poland.
